name: SyncBooking
author: Sync Booking

sections.description:
SyncBooking turns your WordPress site into a direct-booking website: a floating booking bar, a self-contained booking page with real-time availability, and a booking-management page. Availability, rooms, prices, page content and design come from your SyncBooking account; guests complete the reservation on the SyncBooking checkout.

External Services

This plugin connects to the SyncBooking service to validate the API key, fetch availability and page content, complete the booking, and to load the booking-page fonts and map.

  1. SyncBooking Availability API

    • What: returns available rooms, prices and the booking-page content as JSON
    • Data sent: structure id, selected dates, number of houses/rooms and guests, language
    • When: when the booking page loads and on each search
    • Where: https://booking.syncbooking.com/api-search
    • Provider: SyncBooking.com — Terms https://syncbooking.com/terms · Privacy https://syncbooking.com/privacy

  2. SyncBooking Email API

    • What: emails the reservation details to the guest
    • Data sent: guest email address and booking code
    • When: when the guest requests their booking on the “Manage booking” page
    • Where: https://booking.syncbooking.com/api-send-email/
    • Provider: SyncBooking.com

  3. SyncBooking Checkout

    • What: page where the guest completes the reservation
    • Data sent: selected room id, dates and price (in the redirect URL)
    • When: when the guest clicks “Select offer”
    • Where: https://booking.syncbooking.com/cart/
    • Provider: SyncBooking.com

  4. SyncBooking Account / API key

    • What: validates the API key and links the site to the structure
    • Data sent: site URL and API key
    • When: when connecting the plugin (Connect tab)
    • Where: https://admin.syncbooking.com
    • Provider: SyncBooking.com

  5. SyncBooking Theme Assets

    • What: downloads the booking-page CSS/JS into uploads/ (images excluded)
    • Data sent: none (a file download)
    • When: from the “Theme Assets” page and on a twice-daily automatic check
    • Where: https://syncbooking.com/clone-theme/theme-01/assets.zip
    • Provider: SyncBooking.com

  6. Google Fonts

    • What: loads the booking-page fonts (Cormorant Garamond + Jost)
    • Data sent: none (font files; the visitor’s browser requests them)
    • When: on the booking, manage and booking-bar pages
    • Where: https://fonts.googleapis.com
    • Provider: Google LLC — Terms https://policies.google.com/terms · Privacy https://policies.google.com/privacy

  7. Google Maps (embed)

    • What: shows the property location in an embedded map
    • Data sent: the property coordinates (no visitor data sent by the plugin)
    • When: in the “Location & Arrival” section of the booking page
    • Where: https://www.google.com/maps
    • Provider: Google LLC

No personal data is transmitted unless triggered by an explicit user action (searching availability, requesting a booking by email, or proceeding to checkout).

Source Code

All JavaScript shipped with this plugin is custom and provided as readable (non-minified) source.

  • php/bar-sync/js/bar.js – booking bar: date-range calendar and submit. Custom, readable.
  • php/theme-sync/js/syncbooking_site.js – booking/manage page header, footer, menu, lightbox and interactions, built from window.SBTW_CONFIG. Readable.
  • php/bar-sync/js/syncbooking_bar.js – booking bar palette (applies window.syncbooking_BAR colours to CSS variables). Readable.
  • The booking and manage page scripts (date picker, modal, AJAX search, checkout redirect) are inline in the page templates and fully readable.

No build tools (npm, webpack, etc.) are required to use or extend this plugin. Developers may edit the provided source files directly.
sections.changelog:
1.72.27

  • Ricerca senza disponibilita’: ordine dei blocchi corretto. Ora e’ sempre “No accommodation available for the selected dates.” subito seguito da “For these dates we have only these options” (se presente), e SOLO dopo l’eventuale offerta Split Booking – prima l’ordine era invertito.

1.72.26

  • Ricerca senza disponibilita’: la lista “For these dates we have only these options” ora compare sempre (quando ci sono finestre di date libere vicine), non solo quando lo Split Booking non e’ disponibile. Split Booking (se valido) e la lista si sommano, cosi’ l’utente vede sia l’opzione un click che tutte le alternative singole.

1.72.25

  • Fallback “For these dates we have only these options”: ogni finestra di date ora e’ un link cliccabile che rilancia la ricerca su quelle date esatte (1 casa, stessi ospiti richiesti), invece di essere solo testo informativo.

1.72.24

  • Split Booking: non piu’ proposto quando sono state richieste 2 o piu’ case. Lo split dell’api-search e’ sempre 1 stanza alla volta in sequenza (mai 2+ stanze contemporanee), quindi non risponde a una richiesta di piu’ stanze simultanee – in quel caso si passa direttamente al fallback “For these dates we have only these options”.

1.72.23

  • Split Booking: l’offerta di split proposta dall’api-search viene mostrata solo se OGNI singolo soggiorno (stanza) regge da solo il numero di ospiti richiesto – non basta che la somma delle capienze delle 2 stanze lo faccia. Prima poteva capitare di vedere “Split Booking” con 2 stanze da 2/3 persone anche avendo cercato 4 adulti, che pero’ occupano una stanza sola per volta durante ciascun segmento.

1.72.22

  • Ricerca senza disponibilita’: quando nessuna stanza copre l’intero periodo richiesto ma l’api-search propone gia’ uno “split” (2 soggiorni consecutivi in stanze diverse che coprono insieme tutte le date), lo mostriamo come offerta “Split Booking” prenotabile con un click, con titolo/descrizione/prezzo reali e i 2 soggiorni in dettaglio. Se nemmeno lo split e’ possibile, mostriamo le finestre di date realmente libere piu’ vicine (“For these dates we have only these options: dal X al Y abbiamo…”). In entrambi i casi il messaggio “No accommodation available for the selected dates.” resta sempre il primo a comparire.

1.72.21

  • Calendario: la restrizione “soggiorno continuo massimo” (voluta rimossa nella 1.72.20, ma il codice era rimasto attivo) e’ stata tolta per davvero da bar.js/sync-bar.php – dopo aver scelto il check-in tutte le date restano cliccabili come check-out; solo i giorni realmente sold-out (is-full) restano bloccati/sbarrati.

1.72.20

  • Calendario: rimossa la restrizione “soggiorno continuo massimo” che sbarrava le date dopo aver scelto il check-in; restano bloccati solo i giorni realmente sold-out (is-full). Nessuna limitazione basata sul numero di case/ospiti scelti.

1.72.19

  • Checkout: “Select offer” ora manda totalreal/totaltopay arrotondati a 2 decimali (es. 15.50 resta 15.50) invece che arrotondati all’intero (perdendo i centesimi dell’acconto).

1.72.18

  • Avviso capienza insufficiente: le opzioni disponibili ora sono un elenco puntato, a capo, con il testo in grassetto (es. “4 adults in 1 room”), invece di un elenco in linea separato da virgole.

1.72.17

  • Calendario: le date bloccate (sold-out o oltre il soggiorno disponibile per case/ospiti scelti) restano ora sbarrate anche dopo aver completato la selezione check-in/check-out, invece di tornare tutte cliccabili.

1.72.16

  • Avviso capienza insufficiente: ogni capienza effettivamente disponibile (es. “2 adults, 1 room”) e’ ora un link cliccabile che rilancia la ricerca gia’ impostata su quei parametri, stesse date.

1.72.15

  • Select your accommodation: se nessuna combinazione (a nessun numero di case) copre gli ospiti richiesti, invece del solo messaggio “non disponibile” vengono ora mostrate (in inglese) le stanze effettivamente disponibili con capienza inferiore, ordinate dalla piu’ capiente, con un avviso esplicativo.

1.72.14

  • Select your accommodation: se il numero di case scelto non basta per gli ospiti richiesti (es. 5 persone con 1 sola stanza), viene ora proposta automaticamente la combinazione con 1 casa in piu’ (poi 2, ecc.) che copre la richiesta, con la stessa logica di combinazioni gia’ in uso.

1.72.13

  • Calendario: le date di check-out ora tengono conto del numero di case e ospiti scelti, nascondendo (sbarrando) quelle oltre il soggiorno continuo realmente disponibile per quella combinazione (es. 1 stanza da 4 persone con solo stanze da 2/3 disponibili, o 2+ stanze con solo 1 disponibile in continuo).
  • Card “Accommodation for N units”: ora mostra il prezzo totale della combinazione e la media del prezzo/notte di tutte le stanze, non piu’ il prezzo della sola prima stanza.

1.72.12

  • Select your accommodation: le offerte multi-casa ora mostrano tutte le combinazioni uniche di stanze disponibili (mai la stessa coppia invertita), non solo blocchi consecutivi, con un limite di 2 combinazioni per ogni fascia di capienza totale per non generare troppe card. Limite di sicurezza automatico anche per proprieta’ con moltissime unita’ disponibili.

1.72.11

  • Select your accommodation: le stanze/combo ora vengono ordinate per capienza crescente ed escluse se la capienza totale del gruppo non basta per gli ospiti richiesti (es. con 4 adulti non escono piu’ le stanze da 2 posti; con 2 case e 4 adulti escono prima le coppie da 2+2 invece di quelle piu’ capienti).

1.72.10

  • Pulizia URL della barra di ricerca: rimosso il parametro “Structure” (mai usato lato server) e unificati “Guests”/”house_number” nei nomi canonici “syncbooking_guests”/”syncbooking_houses”, eliminando parametri duplicati/in conflitto dopo una ricerca. La ricerca ora applica automaticamente la selezione date anche se non si clicca esplicitamente “Apply” nel calendario.

1.72.9

  • Pagina booking: quando la ricerca richiede piu’ case (Rooms > 1), le unita’ disponibili vengono ora raggruppate in un’unica offerta combinata con badge “N Rooms”, box “This offer includes N rooms” e prenotazione unica (room_id multipli). Aggiunta anche la descrizione troncata con “Show more” su tutte le card.

1.72.8

  • Barra di ricerca della pagina booking allineata al nuovo mockup theme01: “Structure” e “Guests”/”Number of Houses” ora sono celle a tendina (popover) invece di semplici select, con “Guests” e “Rooms” uniti in un unico popover.

1.72.7

  • Calendario: i giorni oltre il soggiorno continuo massimo disponibile (dopo aver scelto il check-in) ora mostrano la stessa grafica sbarrata dei giorni sold-out, invece del solo numero sbiadito.

1.72.6

  • Appearance sync to admin.syncbooking.com now uses the agreed JSON schema: marker, website, api_key, token, colors split into “bar” and “site”, and the resolved menu as link/group items. It is sent on every Save and automatically once a day.

1.72.5

  • Connect: updated for the new api_data_wp endpoint � the popup now uses the default postMessage mode (no extra flag) and the plugin closes the popup automatically as soon as the API key is received.

1.72.4

  • “From SyncBooking / Theme” menu now matches the live site exactly: when the SyncBooking theme is active on the same site, the booking page reads the theme’s own resolved navigation (same items, submenus and URLs) instead of the structure API menu. Falls back to the API structure menu only if the theme is not present.

1.72.3

  • Admin: the search-and-book menu settings moved into the “Site Colors & Booking bar & Menu” card. You can now choose the menu source: “From SyncBooking / Theme (structure menu)” or “Custom (create the items below)”. The booking page shows the structure menu or your custom items accordingly.

1.72.2

  • Connect: the “Connect to SyncBooking” popup now opens the endpoint with cb=postmessage and reads the api_key from the returned postMessage (matching the updated SyncBooking endpoint). The admin JavaScript was re-saved as UTF-8 and is now cache-busted on the plugin version.

1.72.1

  • The search-and-book menu now comes ONLY from the items set in the plugin Menu card (no fallback to the API); the “Menu source” choice was removed � build or import the items and they are saved in the plugin and shown directly. “Import from SyncBooking” fills the builder so the items get saved on Save. Removed menu_source from the api-save-colors-menu payload.

1.72.0

  • New admin “Menu” card: choose the search-and-book menu source (from SyncBooking/theme structure menu, or a custom menu you build with label + URL rows, with a “Copy from SyncBooking” helper). The booking page uses the custom menu when selected. On Save, the appearance (Site Colors model, bar style, resolved palette and menu) is sent to admin.syncbooking.com/api-save-colors-menu.

1.71.4

  • Admin (Connect tab): the API Key field is now read-only and is unlocked only by clicking “Connect to SyncBooking”; the activation note was moved up next to the connection steps.

1.71.3

  • Admin: text inputs and selects on the settings page now share a consistent height, width and font size.

1.71.2

  • Admin: the plugin version is shown next to the “SyncBooking Settings” title; the plugin menu now appears just above “Appearance” in the sidebar; the settings tabs are simplified to Connect, Edit Structure and Contact (the last two open admin.syncbooking.com); removed the line under the tab bar.

1.71.1

  • Cleanup: removed the now-unused bundled files (theme01-site.css, theme01-site.js, the legacy bar.css) that were superseded by the local syncbooking_site.* and syncbooking_bar.* assets.

1.71.0

  • The booking bar and the booking/manage pages now load their CSS and JavaScript locally from the plugin (no online asset dependency) for simpler, predictable behaviour. The booking page adopts the refreshed design assets (syncbooking_site.css/js) and adds a floating WhatsApp button using the structure phone number.

1.70.0

  • Booking calendar: after picking a check-in day, the calendar now limits the check-out to the longest continuous single-room stay starting that day (computed from per-room availability sent by the API as “rooms”). Days beyond that run are greyed out and clicking one starts a new check-in. Works on both the home bar and the booking page, and is backward compatible (if the API does not send per-room data, the calendar behaves as before).

1.69.1

  • The “Booking bar style” control is now a dropdown select, so one option is always selected and switching between Bar 1 and Bar 2 just changes the dropdown (no reload); the choice is saved with the bottom “Save Changes” button.

1.69.0

  • The booking bar now uses a dedicated, self-contained stylesheet and palette script (syncbooking_bar.css / syncbooking_bar.js) loaded from the online asset pipeline, with bundled fallbacks; bar colours are passed via window.syncbooking_BAR following the selected Site Colors model, so the bar look can be updated online without releasing the plugin. The “Check for updates” link now shows a result notice (installed version vs the version published on WordPress.org vs what WordPress’s update service is offering), making it clear when the update service is lagging and a manual install is needed. Admin: added spacing between the navigation tabs and the cards below.

1.68.1

  • Fix: the Booking bar style now shows the “Active” badge on the selected bar and defaults to “Bar 1 — Full” when no value is stored (a previously emptied option left neither bar marked active). The Site Colors model falls back to Model 1 when the stored value is empty/invalid.

1.68.0

  • Fix: Site Colors and Booking bar style now actually save — a stray outer form wrapped the settings tab, nesting it inside the tab’s own form and breaking the “Save Changes” button; the duplicate form was removed so all settings (colours, bar style, contact page, credit, selected pages) save correctly. Fix: the booking-bar calendar’s struck-through sold-out days are shown again (the strike styling is now injected inline, so it survives loading the bar CSS from the online site.css). Admin cleanup: removed the “Customer Support” header; numbered the card titles (1–4); removed the redundant “Open your Booking Page” instructions card and moved the “Powered by SyncBooking” footer-credit option into the API key card; merged “Site Colors” and “Booking bar style” into a single card.

1.67.0

  • The booking bar now follows the selected Site Colors model (red for Model 1, gold for Models 2/3) instead of always using the red bar. The bar stylesheet is now loaded online from the theme’s site.css (with a bundled fallback), so its look can be updated without releasing the plugin. The bar calendar now allows selecting today (same-day check-in), matching the booking page.

1.66.0

  • Admin: the descriptive “how to” step cards are merged into the cards that hold the actual controls (API key + Connect, the booking/manage/contact page selectors). Site Colors and Booking bar style are now selected without reloading the page and are saved together with the bottom “Save Changes” button (the Custom colour editor is part of the same form). Booking page: the internal date calendar now strikes through and disables sold-out days (preloaded server-side, like the home bar). Before a search the booking page now shows a friendly prompt (“Please select your dates above to see the available units.”) instead of the empty-results message.

1.65.0

  • Booking-bar calendar: sold-out days are now preloaded server-side for the two visible months (cached) and injected into the page, so they are struck through and disabled immediately without depending on the AJAX call; the proxy still serves further months when navigating. Admin: fixed the “Select Contact Page” row (select + View button) and the colour/bar-style selectable rows overflowing their card on mobile.

1.64.0

  • Booking-bar calendar: the availability proxy now calls the correct endpoint (POST https://booking.syncbooking.com/api-availability/) using the sb_year/sb_month parameters, and reads the returned “unavailable_days” to strike through and disable sold-out days. Fixes the previous endpoint that returned 404.

1.63.0

  • New “Booking bar style” setting: choose between the full bar (dates, guests and availability search) and a simple bar with just “Book Now” and “Contact Us” buttons. Both styles follow the same Site Colors model. The booking-bar calendar now marks sold-out/full days (struck through and not selectable), loaded per month from the structure’s availability through a same-origin proxy. Removed unused leftover assets (Webflow scripts and badge images) from the plugin package.

1.62.0

  • Admin settings are now fully responsive on phones and tablets: cards stack to full width, the EN/IT language toggle no longer overlaps the title, the page/post selector and colour swatches wrap cleanly, inputs and selects never overflow the screen, and the navigation tabs wrap. The booking-bar structure label (House/Room/Masseria…) is now derived automatically from the structure type, so the separate “What do you Sell?” admin control was removed.

1.61.0

  • When a search returns no availability the section heading now reads “No accommodation available” (instead of “Select your accommodation”). Updated the readme description, External Services and Source Code sections to match the current plugin (removed the no-longer-used Webflow fonts, Cloudflare Turnstile and Google IMA references; documented the SyncBooking availability/email/checkout APIs, theme-assets download, Google Fonts and Maps).

1.60.0

  • Booking page now only shows the accommodation area after an actual search: opening the page with no request shows just the search bar and gallery (no “Select your accommodation”, info sections or sidebar). When a search returns no availability, only the “No accommodation available” message is shown — the amenities/location/surroundings/good-to-know/offers sections and the support sidebar are hidden (both server-side and after an AJAX search).

1.59.0

  • Fix: the “Custom” colour model can now actually be activated (it was being reset to Model 1). The 3 fixed models now use the exact colours of their themes, including the bar colour. Fix: the header/footer logo on the booking and manage pages now links to the site home instead of a non-existent home.html. New “What do you Sell?” admin setting to choose the bar’s structure-field label (Houses, Rooms, Masseria, House, Room, Villa).

1.58.0

  • Custom Model colours are now split into “General Colors” and “Bar Colors”. The booking bar exposes granular colours (background, labels, values, Search button background/text/hover) that follow the palette, with sensible fallbacks derived from the primary colour. Updated the bundled theme site.js/site.css. The bar is fully self-contained (own CSS, JS and fonts) so it works on any WordPress theme, not only the SyncBooking theme.

1.57.0

  • Site Colors: the 3 built-in models are fixed presets and the “Custom Model” is now a separate option — its colour editor only appears once Custom is activated, so the preset models can’t be altered by mistake.

1.56.0

  • Fix: the floating booking bar (on the homepage and other pages) now follows the selected “Site Colors” palette too. Previously the bar kept the old remote brand colour. The palette helpers are now available site-wide so the bar background, the Search button, the calendar and the neutral tones all match the chosen model/custom colours.

1.55.0

  • Colours now apply reliably on the live page: the chosen palette is printed as CSS variables directly in the page head (server-side), so it works even when the downloaded theme site.js is an older version. The “Custom Model” now exposes the full palette (page background, surface, text, secondary text, borders, primary / deep / soft, rose, gold). Booking page set to English only (multi-language switcher disabled for now).

1.54.0

  • Multi-language booking page: a new admin “Booking page Languages” card lets you enable EN (base) + IT and optionally FR/DE/ES. For each enabled language the plugin creates a dedicated booking page (search-and-book-xx) and shows a language switcher in the header; each page requests its content from the API with the matching lang parameter.

1.53.0

  • Site Colors: removed the duplicate read-only colour card; the picker is now a single card and adds a “Custom Model” where you can choose every colour yourself. Admin: the “Theme Assets” page is now in English (with the IT toggle), continuing the English-first admin.

1.52.0

  • Admin: added a “Site Colors” picker to choose one of the 3 built-in palettes directly in the plugin (no longer fetched from the remote service). The “Custom Top Bar” selector is now split into separate Pages and Posts lists with Select all / Deselect all buttons. Added a “Check for updates” action on the Plugins page. The admin settings now default to English with an EN/IT language toggle at the top.

1.51.0

  • Booking checkout simplified to a single room (split selection removed, to be reintroduced later). Updated the bundled theme site.js/site.css. Colours are no longer pulled from the remote service: the booking and manage pages now use one of three built-in “Site Colors” palettes (selectable per site), defaulting to the warm-red model.

1.50.0

  • Booking page: the top structure gallery and each room’s “All Photos” now use the photos coming from the API JSON (full galleries), opening in the theme lightbox. Clicking “Select offer” now selects the room and redirects to the booking.syncbooking.com checkout (cart) with the dates, room id and price/deposit, matching the original flow; multi-house bookings accumulate one room per house before checkout.

1.49.1

  • Republish of 1.49.0 with the complete file set (a transient packaging issue could leave the booking template file missing, resulting in a blank booking page). No functional changes versus 1.49.0.

1.49.0

  • Booking page search is now instant (AJAX): selecting dates/guests and clicking Search updates the accommodation list in place from the API, without reloading the whole page, and keeps the URL shareable (falls back to a normal reload if JavaScript or the request fails). Tidied the plugin folder to a flat layout (booking.php, manage.php, functions/, js/, css/).

1.48.0

  • Manage-booking page rebuilt as a single self-contained template like the booking page: theme header/footer via site.js (window.SBTW_CONFIG), retrieve-by-email form with inline JS. Big cleanup: removed the old shared header/footer includes, the legacy asset-enqueue layer and the no-longer-used scripts (calendar/next/send-email/chrome) and bundled flatpickr/glightbox libraries. Both plugin pages are now self-contained and load only the theme assets plus the bundled bk- styles.

1.47.0

  • Fix: the booking page inner sections were unstyled when the downloaded site.css was an older version without the bk- booking styles. The page now also loads the current bk-/sb-/co- plugin-page styles bundled with the plugin (on top of the downloaded site.css), so the layout always matches the theme. Also read the booking bar parameters (syncbooking_houses / syncbooking_guests) for availability and the search form state.

1.46.0

  • Booking page header/footer now built by the theme site.js from a per-structure config (window.SBTW_CONFIG): brand/logo, navigation menu, address, contacts and socials are injected from the API JSON. Bundled the updated theme site.js/site.css as a fallback when the downloaded assets are unavailable. Cleanup: removed the now-unused booking includes (search, gallery and service popups) after the page became a single self-contained template.

1.45.0

  • Booking page fully rebuilt as a single self-contained template matching the theme01 booking layout (v6.0): fixed search bar with a built-in date-range calendar, structure gallery, two-column content (accommodation, amenities, location, surroundings, good-to-know, offers) and a sticky support sidebar, plus a details modal. The page now loads only the downloaded site.css/site.js. Room availability is fetched from the external API as JSON and rendered server-side in PHP (no HTML received from the API). Only texts and photo URLs are dynamic.

1.44.0

  • Big cleanup of php/theme-sync: removed the old Webflow CSS (normalize, webflow, booking-8aa063), the Webflow/webfont JS and ~90 unused bundled images. The booking/manage pages now load only the theme01 assets (downloaded site.css + theme01 skin + bk- styles) and the functional scripts (flatpickr, glightbox, calendar, next, send-email, mobile menu). Header cleaned of Webflow markup; favicon/og:image now use the structure logo.

1.43.0

  • Search results now styled with the exact theme01 bk- classes (paired with the api-search backend update): room cards, info sections, tabs and empty state. The results no longer depend on the old Webflow CSS for styling.

1.42.0

  • Cleanup: removed unused legacy chrome includes (navbar-wrapper, fixed-wrapper, header_functions) no longer referenced after the theme01 header/footer.

1.41.0

  • Booking page rebuilt to match the theme01 mockup exactly: bk- search bar, bk- gallery grid and bk- page styles, on top of the theme header/footer. The results area (bk-page) is filled by the api-search backend.

1.40.0

  • Theme assets: the download section is now a sub-page of the SyncBooking menu (not a separate menu). More robust download (longer time limit, wp_remote_get fallback) and the real error message is shown when it fails.

1.39.0

  • New “SyncBooking Tema” admin page that downloads the theme CSS/JS from the remote assets.zip into uploads/syncbooking-theme01/ (images skipped) and auto-refreshes it twice a day when the remote zip changes. The booking page now loads site.css from there (falls back to the bundled copy).

1.38.0

  • Booking & manage pages now use the exact theme01 header and footer (real site.css), populated with the structure’s own logo, menu items and socials. Added the theme fonts (Cormorant Garamond + Jost) and a mobile menu drawer.

1.37.0

  • Results polish: strip stray PHP notices from the backend response, stop a horizontal scrollbar caused by the offers slider, hide the Webflow form status messages and the duplicate mobile amenities row.

1.36.0

  • Fix: the booking page search now calls the new backend endpoint (/api-search) instead of the retired /search/ (which returned 404, so no results showed). Availability calendar unchanged.

1.35.0

  • Booking page: the whole section after the gallery (accommodation results, info sections and support) now comes entirely from the api-search backend; the plugin only provides the container. Added theme01 styling for the injected results (room cards, prices, amenities, info sections).

1.34.0

  • Fix: the booking/manage page header was oversized (a CSS class-name collision made the “Manage Booking” link inherit the page-wrapper min-height). Renamed the wrapper class. Tidier footer (hide empty social links, show structure name).

1.33.0

  • Compatibility: tested up to WordPress 7.0.

1.32.0

short_description: SyncBooking turns your WordPress site into a direct-booking website: a floating booking bar, a self-contained booking page with real-time availability …
description:
SyncBooking turns your WordPress site into a direct-booking website: a floating booking bar, a self-contained booking page with real-time availability, and a booking-management page. Availability, rooms, prices, page content and design come from your SyncBooking account; guests complete the reservation on the SyncBooking checkout.

External Services

This plugin connects to the SyncBooking service to validate the API key, fetch availability and page content, complete the booking, and to load the booking-page fonts and map.

  1. SyncBooking Availability API

    • What: returns available rooms, prices and the booking-page content as JSON
    • Data sent: structure id, selected dates, number of houses/rooms and guests, language
    • When: when the booking page loads and on each search
    • Where: https://booking.syncbooking.com/api-search
    • Provider: SyncBooking.com — Terms https://syncbooking.com/terms · Privacy https://syncbooking.com/privacy

  2. SyncBooking Email API

    • What: emails the reservation details to the guest
    • Data sent: guest email address and booking code
    • When: when the guest requests their booking on the “Manage booking” page
    • Where: https://booking.syncbooking.com/api-send-email/
    • Provider: SyncBooking.com

  3. SyncBooking Checkout

    • What: page where the guest completes the reservation
    • Data sent: selected room id, dates and price (in the redirect URL)
    • When: when the guest clicks “Select offer”
    • Where: https://booking.syncbooking.com/cart/
    • Provider: SyncBooking.com

  4. SyncBooking Account / API key

    • What: validates the API key and links the site to the structure
    • Data sent: site URL and API key
    • When: when connecting the plugin (Connect tab)
    • Where: https://admin.syncbooking.com
    • Provider: SyncBooking.com

  5. SyncBooking Theme Assets

    • What: downloads the booking-page CSS/JS into uploads/ (images excluded)
    • Data sent: none (a file download)
    • When: from the “Theme Assets” page and on a twice-daily automatic check
    • Where: https://syncbooking.com/clone-theme/theme-01/assets.zip
    • Provider: SyncBooking.com

  6. Google Fonts

    • What: loads the booking-page fonts (Cormorant Garamond + Jost)
    • Data sent: none (font files; the visitor’s browser requests them)
    • When: on the booking, manage and booking-bar pages
    • Where: https://fonts.googleapis.com
    • Provider: Google LLC — Terms https://policies.google.com/terms · Privacy https://policies.google.com/privacy

  7. Google Maps (embed)

    • What: shows the property location in an embedded map
    • Data sent: the property coordinates (no visitor data sent by the plugin)
    • When: in the “Location & Arrival” section of the booking page
    • Where: https://www.google.com/maps
    • Provider: Google LLC

No personal data is transmitted unless triggered by an explicit user action (searching availability, requesting a booking by email, or proceeding to checkout).

Source Code

All JavaScript shipped with this plugin is custom and provided as readable (non-minified) source.

  • php/bar-sync/js/bar.js – booking bar: date-range calendar and submit. Custom, readable.
  • php/theme-sync/js/syncbooking_site.js – booking/manage page header, footer, menu, lightbox and interactions, built from window.SBTW_CONFIG. Readable.
  • php/bar-sync/js/syncbooking_bar.js – booking bar palette (applies window.syncbooking_BAR colours to CSS variables). Readable.
  • The booking and manage page scripts (date picker, modal, AJAX search, checkout redirect) are inline in the page templates and fully readable.

No build tools (npm, webpack, etc.) are required to use or extend this plugin. Developers may edit the provided source files directly.
